acceptance: Red test first: a ship with AUDIT_BINDING_HEAD_MOVED and an unchanged lane patch id re-binds without dispatching audit.
A changed lane diff still gets an LLM audit round.
The spend reader counts a re-bind as no audit round.

consumed.resolution: A moved main over a pending, unchanged lane now rebases through the ADR-0105 identity carry and re-binds the audit with no audit round (head_moved_rebind.go, carryReboundHead); a changed lane still gets an audit round; ORCHESTRATOR_SHIP_RECOVERY_PATH records the path

fix: When the rebased lane diff is unchanged (same patch id) or the only change is the merge of main with no conflict, re-run the deterministic floor and re-bind the audit to the new HEAD without an LLM audit round. Run an LLM audit only when the lane diff itself changed. Record which path ran.
notes: Console route: ship and core are on the fence.
source: console, 2026-10-27, operator "investigate in watcher issue"; wave-145 errors channel 10:05Z-12:40Z (1387 WARN signals)
summary: In wave 145, cycles 2058, 2060 and 2062 reached 3 audit rounds (CYCLE_SPEND_LIMIT would_stop on max_audit_rounds 3 of 2). Their ships aborted with AUDIT_BINDING_HEAD_MOVED or GIT_FLEET_REBASE_NEEDED and recovered by running audit again (ORCHESTRATOR_PHASE_ABORTED: ship error ... recovering via audit). A main that moved under a clean lane costs a full LLM audit round.
title: A ship that finds main moved re-checks the rebased diff deterministically instead of a full audit round
